title: Grouping and universal selectors
learningObjectives: Choose and write maintainable CSS selectors for grouping and universal selectors.

understand.concept: A comma-separated selector list applies the same declarations to multiple selectors. The universal selector * matches all elements; use it thoughtfully.
understand.whyItMatters: Good selectors target intended elements and keep styles maintainable.
understand.analogy: Selectors are like finding items in a list by their labels or relationships.
understand.analogyLimit: Selectors are not just labels; the document tree, state and specificity also matter.

explain.narrative: A comma-separated selector list applies the same declarations to multiple selectors. The universal selector * matches all elements; use it thoughtfully.
